explanation: In Saudi Arabia, the left hand is traditionally considered unclean and is reserved for hygiene tasks. Using it to eat, especially in a restaurant or when sharing food, is seen as disrespectful and unhygienic. This custom is rooted in Islamic teachings and deeply observed across the country.
local_tip: Always use your right hand for eating, even for picking up bread or small items, and keep your left hand under the table or resting on your lap.

also_check.note: Left hand is considered unclean and used for toilet purposes; eat with right hand only.
Chopsticks are used with either hand, but left-handedness is socially accepted.
No stigma against left-handed eating; both hands are considered equally acceptable.
